machine_validation.value: All selected units must pass common validation and the final published artifact check.
machine_validation.rationale: The existing pipeline only publishes validated complete output.
machine_validation.impact: One failing unit prevents acceptance; this does not establish meaning quality.

mistranslation.value: No material mistranslations in the reviewed set.
mistranslation.rationale: A human must determine whether meaning is preserved.
mistranslation.impact: A material error blocks candidate acceptance until resolved.

omission.value: No material omissions in the reviewed set.
omission.rationale: Structural validation alone does not establish semantic completeness.
omission.impact: A material omission blocks candidate acceptance until resolved.

readability.value: Each reviewed translation is understandable in context.
readability.impact: Unclear text requires human review; context may be insufficient in the current samples.

terminology.value: Use agreed required terminology consistently in the reviewed set.
terminology.rationale: Names and terms should be understandable and consistent.
terminology.impact: The terminology list and treatment of disagreements require confirmation.

units.rationale: Candidate includes all 19 BetterKeybinds and 30 MonsterOfTheWeek entries.
units.impact: These are small UI samples and do not establish dialogue or large-MOD coverage.

text_bytes.rationale: The selected 49 entries total 259 + 223 decoded UTF-8 source bytes.
text_bytes.impact: This small total is not a maximum supported MOD size.

artifact_bytes.rationale: The two selected original binaries total 952 + 1122 bytes.
artifact_bytes.impact: This total describes two separate small files; product limits apply to each artifact.

duration_seconds.rationale: Candidate ceiling per fresh CUDA fixture run; docs/evidence/cuda-inference/product-wrapper/matrix/02-x4-pair1-cuda.supervisor.json process_wall_seconds=17.3824957649922 for a different 76-label workload, so 60 s is an approximately 3.45x manual margin.
duration_seconds.impact: Includes model load, production pipeline, independent reader and child reaping; unmeasured v0.23 E2E overhead may exceed it. A failure needs review, not automatic retry or limit expansion; confirm scope and value in #85.

ram_bytes.rationale: Candidate 5 GiB translation-process RSS high-water; docs/evidence/cuda-inference/product-wrapper/matrix/01-fixture-pair3-cuda.json peak_rss_kib=3761148 (about 3.587 GiB), giving an approximately 1.39x manual margin.
ram_bytes.impact: Applies per CUDA fixture to the translation process only, excludes runner/oracle and host totals; v0.23 E2E is unmeasured and a breach needs review. Confirm in #85.

vram_bytes.rationale: Candidate 3 GiB sampled translation-process VRAM maximum; docs/evidence/cuda-inference/product-wrapper/matrix/02-long-pair3-cuda.supervisor.json process_vram_sampled_max_mib=1838 (about 1.795 GiB), giving an approximately 1.67x manual margin.
vram_bytes.impact: Applies per CUDA fixture to sampled process VRAM, not continuous peak, total device memory or a minimum GPU requirement; missing samples cannot pass. v0.23 E2E is unmeasured; confirm in #85.
